title: Storm-3068 Hijacks Azure DevOps Pipelines to Steal Kubernetes Credentials After Account Takeover
content_md: Microsoft has detailed a cloud-focused intrusion attributed to Storm-3068, in which attackers turned a compromised user account into a launch point for Azure DevOps abuse, Kubernetes credential theft, and potential access to connected cloud environments.
